title: Two-norm hypercontractivity in every dimension
statement: Let $q\ge2$. For every natural number $m$ and every real-valued function $f$ on $\{-1,1\}^m$, applying the noise operator with parameter $1/\sqrt{q-1}$ to $f$ gives a function whose uniform $L^q$ norm is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$.
